entities.summary: Rodolfo Halffter Escriche was a Spanish composer, music critic, and professor with Mexican citizenship. He wrote in a style always informed by his early engagement with the modernist aesthetics of Madrid's Grupo de los Ocho, finding inspiration in the music of Claude Debussy, Manuel de Falla, and Arnold Schoenberg.
